Balancing gives:
\[
\mathrm{C_2H_6 + 2Cl_2 \rightarrow C_2H_4Cl_2 + 2HCl}
\]
From the balanced equation, 2 mol \(\mathrm{Cl_2}\) react with 1 mol \(\mathrm{C_2H_6}\).  
For 6 mol \(\mathrm{Cl_2}\):
\[
6\ \text{mol Cl}_2 \times \frac{1\ \text{mol C}_2\text{H}_6}{2\ \text{mol Cl}_2}=3\ \text{mol C}_2\text{H}_6
\]

\boxed{3}
